title: Carrying a Granite Ridge Season Pass Forward to the Following Season
content:
Where the tier offers it, a holder who cannot ski the season may carry the pass forward to the following season instead of giving it up.

**The election period.** A carry-forward is accepted only when it is recorded no later than the election period counted in calendar days from the day the pass was activated. Calendar days are counted forward from the anchor date, the anchor date itself counting as day zero, every day of the week counting alike, and a calendar day is never mixed with a full 24-hour period; where the resulting boundary falls on a date that does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used. The comparison is not-later-than and the boundary day itself satisfies it.

**No day taken.** A carry-forward is accepted only when the collective's scan records show no day used on the pass in the season being given up. The scan records answer this, not the holder's account of whether they skied.

**The fee.** The clause placing the tier's carry-forward fee on the pass account when the election is recorded, and not charging that fee where the household holds a protection plan standing in force or with a claim open at the moment of the election, is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded, and what is placed on the pass account for the election is governed by the current basis for that fee. The carry-forward fee and the election period published for each tier in this charter are unaffected and remain in force as the tier's published figures.

**What the pass comes back as.** The carried-forward pass returns at the tier it was bought at and at the price already committed to, even where that tier's price has moved; it is not repriced and it does not earn the renewal reduction a second time.

**Not both.** A pass carried forward may not also be cancelled for a refund, because the value has already been moved rather than returned.

**When it is live again.** The pass becomes scannable again on the opening day of the season it was carried forward to, and a pass carried forward that is not used in that season expires with no further value.

**Which tiers may elect at all.** A carry-forward is elected only on a tier that is itself eligible to carry a protection plan, because the carry-forward and the protection plan are the two routes the collective offers to the same relief and it offers neither on a tier sold without the other.

### The election period at its boundary

Hypothetical dates on a Granite Ridge Local Pass, whose election period is 21 calendar days: the pass was activated on the 10th of a month. Counting that day as day zero, day 21 falls on the 31st. An election recorded on the 31st is accepted; one recorded on the 1st of the following month is not, whatever the holder's reason.

superseded_clauses: The tier's carry-forward fee is placed on the pass account when the election is recorded, and that fee is not charged where the household holds a protection plan standing in the active or claim_open state at the moment of the election.
